design_philosophy: Ultra premium digital medical clinic. No frills, high trust, conversion-optimized. Emotionally grounded in longevity, vitality, and prevention. Design uses strict grid alignment, stark contrasts, and Swiss typography to convey medical precision and premium quality.

typography.h1: text-5xl md:text-6xl lg:text-7xl font-light tracking-tighter leading-tight text-slate-900
typography.overline: text-xs md:text-sm uppercase tracking-[0.2em] font-semibold text-slate-500
typography.anti_patterns: Do not use Inter. Never center-align long paragraphs.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous spacing (p-8 to p-24) to create a premium, uncrowded feel.
spacing_and_layout.grid_system: Use The 'Control Room' Grid for stats, and The 'Tetris' Grid for product highlights.
spacing_and_layout.borders: 1px solid #E5E7EB for cards and grid boundaries to expose the structural skeleton.

header.style: Glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70) with a delicate 1px border-b border-gray-200. Sticky top.
header.behavior: Includes Language/Currency auto-detect toggle via geolocation (UI representation), Navigation links (Bracelet Elio, Gilet Elder, Balance Vita, Teleassistance), and primary CTA.

hero.style: Full height or 80vh minimum. Left-aligned typography over a subtle background or split-screen with the hero image. Use a stark, bold H1. CTA should be high-contrast Primary color.
hero.image_overlay: If text overlaps image, use max bg-black/30 or gradient overlay to ensure text contrast while keeping image visible.

product_bento_grid.style: Asymmetric bento grid (Tetris Mode). 1 large hero product (col-span-12 md:col-span-8), 2 secondary products (col-span-12 md:col-span-4). No heavy shadows, just 1px subtle borders.

stats_section.style: Grid Borders ('Technical' look). border-collapse style layout, huge typography for numbers (text-6xl+ font-light). Conveys extreme trust and medical validation.

testimonials.style: Clean, typographic approach. Avoid traditional 'cards'. Use large quote marks, italic serif accents for the quote text, strict alignment.

footer.style: Dark mode contrast (bg-slate-950 text-white) to signal the end of the page. Massive padding (py-24). Simple, strict grid for links.

interactions_and_motion.hover: Subtle -translate-y-1 and shadow-lg on interactive cards. Always explicitly set hover:text colors.
interactions_and_motion.scroll: Use Framer Motion for staggered fade-up entrances for grids. Keep animations smooth, clinical, and precise.

hero_longevity.alt: Elegant healthy mature woman in modern home
hero_longevity.usage: Hero section background or right-split image

store_logos.instruction: Render these as a grayscale marquee or flex row. Use actual text with matching brand font styles if external images fail, but attempt these standard URLs first.

testing.attributes: All interactive elements, buttons, and major sections MUST include 'data-testid' attributes (e.g., data-testid='hero-cta-button', data-testid='product-elio-card').

instructions_to_main_agent: Use standard Tailwind classes. Do NOT write custom CSS unless absolutely necessary.
Ensure 'Outfit' and 'Work Sans' fonts are imported from Google Fonts in index.html or global CSS.
Implement language/currency auto-detect as a visual UI element in the header (e.g., 'FR / EUR' dropdown) with a mock geolocation hook or just a static representation.
For the partner logos, if any image URLs return 404, fallback to rendering the brand name in a clean, bold, uppercase sans-serif text (e.g., DECATHLON). Do NOT use generic image placeholders.
Maintain high contrast. The site must feel like an ultra-premium, modern medical facility. Do not use generic Vercel/Stripe 'SaaS' looks.
Use pure HTML/Tailwind for the marketing layout, avoiding rigid generic UI library cards. Build the bento grid manually with divs.
Ensure the hero image uses the provided URL and spans elegantly, with text highly readable via gradient overlays or split-screen.
Add hover animations to interactive elements explicitly.
Include a strong dark footer to cap the visual experience.
